sections.body: Airport phrases help staff route you to the next counter or service without a long explanation.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use this when your bag did not appear on the carousel. Use it in arrival, immigration, baggage, SIM cards, pickup, and airport services when one clear sentence will work better than a long explanation.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Airport staff may answer by pointing. Follow the gesture first, then ask again if the next step is still unclear.

sections.title: Local tip
sections.body: Keep your passport, baggage tag, or booking screen visible while you ask.
